name: App Icon: Horned Mempo Warlord
purpose: Primary App Store Icon — Warlord Clan Identity.
description: Menacing pitch-black samurai battle helmet (Kabuto) with sweeping golden-crimson crescent horns and a demon Mempo faceplate with glowing crimson eyes, centered on a blazing blood-red solar emblem.
prompt: A masterwork minimalist 2D vector game app icon. Symmetrical pure pitch-black silhouette of a fierce Japanese samurai warlord kabuto helmet with large sharp crescent horns and a demon mempo face mask with glowing crimson-red eye slits. (Directly centered in front of a giant perfectly smooth solid circular crimson-red sun emblem:1.4). Pitch-black background (#07080C), clean hard vector contours, razor-sharp geometric edges, high contrast silhouette poster icon, no human face, no 3D render, no soft painting, no text, no pixelation, no aliasing.
